processSteps.name: Receive Bound Policy Data
processSteps.description: Receive policy binding confirmation and coverage details from underwriting/policy admin
processSteps.inputs: Bound policy data, policy effective dates

processSteps.name: Apply Premium Rating & Schedules
processSteps.description: Calculate premium amounts, apply installment plans, taxes and fee rules
processSteps.inputs: Premium schedules, installment plans, tax/fee rules

processSteps.name: Generate Invoice
processSteps.description: Create invoice with all line items, due dates, and payment instructions

processSteps.name: Validate Invoice Accuracy
processSteps.description: Review invoice for accuracy against policy terms and rating

processSteps.name: Issue Invoice & Create Receivable
processSteps.description: Release invoice to customer/broker and establish receivable record
processSteps.outputs: Issued invoices, receivable records, due-date schedules

processSteps.name: Handle Billing Exceptions
processSteps.description: Research and resolve any billing errors or exceptions identified

processSteps.name: Receive Payment Files
processSteps.description: Ingest bank files, lockbox feeds, and electronic payment confirmations
processSteps.inputs: Bank files, lockbox feeds, payment confirmations

processSteps.name: Match Payments to Invoices
processSteps.description: Auto-match payments to open invoices using reference numbers and amounts

processSteps.name: Apply Cash to Accounts
processSteps.description: Post matched payments to customer accounts and update balances

processSteps.name: Research Suspense Items
processSteps.description: Investigate unmatched payments to identify correct application

processSteps.name: Resolve & Clear Suspense
processSteps.description: Apply researched payments or process refunds for true overpayments

processSteps.name: Reconcile Daily Cash
processSteps.description: Reconcile total cash received to bank deposits and system postings

processSteps.name: Generate Aging Reports
processSteps.description: Produce accounts receivable aging by customer, broker, and aging bucket

processSteps.name: Identify Delinquent Accounts
processSteps.description: Flag accounts past due based on aging thresholds and credit policies

processSteps.name: Issue Dunning Notices
processSteps.description: Send payment reminder letters/emails based on dunning schedule

processSteps.name: Conduct Outbound Collections
processSteps.description: Make collection calls and negotiate payment arrangements
processSteps.inputs: Delinquent accounts, contact info, outreach history

processSteps.name: Establish Payment Arrangements
processSteps.description: Set up and document formal payment plans for delinquent accounts

processSteps.name: Escalate Severely Delinquent
processSteps.description: Escalate accounts to senior recovery or external collections

processSteps.name: Extract Subledger Balances
processSteps.description: Pull AR subledger balances and transaction details

processSteps.name: Extract GL Balances
processSteps.description: Pull general ledger AR account balances

processSteps.name: Perform Reconciliation
processSteps.description: Compare subledger to GL and identify/research variances

processSteps.name: Research & Clear Variances
processSteps.description: Investigate and resolve reconciling items

processSteps.name: Prepare Close Support
processSteps.description: Compile reconciliation package and supporting documentation

processSteps.name: Management Review & Sign-off
processSteps.description: Review and approve reconciliation for period close

processSteps.name: Receive Loss Notice
processSteps.description: Accept first notice of loss via phone, web, email, or agent

processSteps.name: Verify Policy Coverage
processSteps.description: Confirm active policy and coverage at time of loss

processSteps.name: Capture Incident Details
processSteps.description: Document complete facts of the loss incident

processSteps.name: Assess Initial Severity
processSteps.description: Evaluate loss severity and complexity for routing

processSteps.name: Assign Claim to Handler
processSteps.description: Route claim to appropriate adjuster based on expertise and workload

processSteps.name: Send Acknowledgment
processSteps.description: Notify insured of claim receipt and assigned handler

processSteps.name: Review Policy Documents
processSteps.description: Analyze policy wording, endorsements, and coverage limits

processSteps.name: Evaluate Claim Facts vs Coverage
processSteps.description: Compare reported loss facts against policy terms

processSteps.name: Identify Exclusions/Conditions
processSteps.description: Review applicable exclusions and policy conditions

processSteps.name: Determine Coverage Position
processSteps.description: Formalize coverage decision with supporting rationale

processSteps.name: Develop Investigation Plan
processSteps.description: Create plan for claim investigation activities

processSteps.name: Set Initial Reserves
processSteps.description: Establish initial loss reserves based on available information

processSteps.name: Gather Evidence
processSteps.description: Collect photos, statements, reports, and documentation

processSteps.name: Obtain Expert Assessments
processSteps.description: Engage vendors for estimates, IMEs, or specialty evaluations

processSteps.name: Evaluate Liability
processSteps.description: Determine liability/fault based on evidence and applicable law

processSteps.name: Assess Damages
processSteps.description: Quantify covered damages based on estimates and documentation

processSteps.name: Screen for Fraud Indicators
processSteps.description: Review claim for potential fraud red flags

processSteps.name: Update Reserves & Action Plan
processSteps.description: Revise reserves based on investigation findings and plan next steps
processSteps.outputs: Updated reserves, action plan, negotiation posture

processSteps.name: Develop Settlement Strategy
processSteps.description: Determine settlement approach and authority needed

processSteps.name: Negotiate Settlement
processSteps.description: Negotiate settlement terms with claimant/attorney

processSteps.name: Obtain Settlement Authority
processSteps.description: Secure approval for settlement amount and terms

processSteps.name: Process Claim Payment
processSteps.description: Issue payment to claimant/provider per settlement terms

processSteps.name: Identify Recovery Opportunities
processSteps.description: Evaluate salvage and subrogation potential

processSteps.name: Close Claim & Pursue Recoveries
